top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 achievement is mature and scientifically unbroken, from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1 to randomized outcome evidence. A discovery prize should credit the step that opened the field, so I favour Drucker, Holst and Mojsov with a citation on the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form, with incretin therapies named as the consequence. The priority record for the active peptide is contested and I cannot verify it from the supplied materials, so the wording must be careful. P001 (Knudsen in the third seat) is a close and defensible second, and any award is far better than none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; disclosed ties (about twenty co-authored works with Per Svenningsson, one with Abdel El Manira, nuclear-receptor work with Ronald Evans) involve no credited name in P001 or P002
